steps.code:
# Build a mapping of song_id to duration from downloaded songs
downloaded_durations = {song['song_id']: song['duration'] for song in downloaded_songs}

# Check each playlist
qualifying_playlists = []
for playlist in all_playlists:
    song_ids = playlist['song_ids']
    # Check if all songs are downloaded
    if all(sid in downloaded_durations for sid in song_ids):
        total_duration = sum(downloaded_durations[sid] for sid in song_ids)
        if total_duration >= 1800:  # 30 minutes in seconds
            qualifying_playlists.append((playlist['playlist_id'], playlist['title'], total_duration))

print("Qualifying playlists (all songs downloaded, duration >= 30 min):")
for pid, title, dur in qualifying_playlists:
    print(f"ID={pid}, Title={title}, Duration={dur} seconds")
